title: Andy Constan & Jimmy: Tariff Tacos, Bond Carnage & ROW Rotation

excerpts.label: STIR is a bargain
excerpts.insight: Andy sees <1 cut priced over 4 meetings as straight-up cheap; June cut is near-certain
excerpts.pm_takeaway: BUY STIR. <1 cut priced = bargain. June cut locked regardless of Fed chair noise.

excerpts.label: Significant downside to growth
excerpts.insight: Despite 3% GDP, Andy doesn't trust the economy; sees significant downside risk to growth outlook
excerpts.pm_takeaway: FADE hot GDP prints. Don't trust 3% growth—slowdown thesis intact. Position for cuts.

excerpts.label: Exiting US assets at open
excerpts.insight: Full rotation out of US equities/bonds; bearish dollar vs other fiats due to asset flows
excerpts.pm_takeaway: SELL US beta at open. Rotate to ROW/EM. Asset flows all one direction—out of dollar.

excerpts.label: Trump broke the charts
excerpts.insight: NASDAQ through yearly lows; created overhead resistance even on a tariff reversal
excerpts.pm_takeaway: SHORT gap fills. Overhead resistance now structural—taco rallies will fail at old highs.

excerpts.label: Taco trade setup
excerpts.insight: Quick taco = recovery to 6980 area, but then sell—bonds won't rally and curve will get heavy
excerpts.pm_takeaway: SELL ES 6980 gap fill. Bonds won't participate. Curve heaviness drags equities back down.

excerpts.label: No cheap hedges
excerpts.insight: Feb-Mar VIX calendar crushed from $1.25 to $0.50; can't hedge with bonds either
excerpts.pm_takeaway: PASS on hedges now. No cheap vol—recipe for unravel. Wait for post-taco setup.

excerpts.label: Silver to $125
excerpts.insight: Metals consolidating for another leg up; silver wave targets hit $125; trim to neutral, don't short
excerpts.pm_takeaway: HOLD metals—trim overweight to neutral. Consolidation = refresher. $125 silver upside.

excerpts.label: Global back-end repricing
excerpts.insight: JGB selling pulling UST lower; entire back-end of curve globally getting repriced—not about deficit
excerpts.pm_takeaway: WATCH JGB flows. UST weakness = global back-end repricing, not US-specific. Flows to Japan.
